40019972.author: पदार्थः
40019972.content: सुकेशं Sukesha, धार्मिकं righteous, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वरलब्धं having obtained a boon, च and, राक्षसम् the demon, ग्रामणीर्नाम named Gramani, गन्धर्वो a Gandharva, विश्वावसुसमप्रभः having splendor like Vishvavasu.

40019972.author: Translation
40019972.content: Having seen Sukesha, the righteous demon who had obtained a boon, a Gandharva named Gramani, whose splendor was like that of Vishvavasu, (approached him).

40019973.author: पदार्थः
40019973.content: tasya his, devavatī Devavati, nāma named, dvitīyā second, śrīriva like Lakshmi, ātmajā daughter, triṣu in three, lokeṣu worlds, vikhyātā renowned, rūpayauvanaśālinī endowed with beauty and youth, tāṃ her, sukeśāya to Sukesha, dharmeṇa righteously, dadau gave, rakṣaḥśriyaṃ the prosperity of the Rakshasas, yathā just as.

40019973.author: Translation
40019973.content: He had a second daughter named Devavati, renowned in the three worlds for her beauty and youth, whom he righteously gave to Sukesha, just as one would bestow the prosperity of the Rakshasas.

40019974.author: पदार्थः
40019974.content: varadānakṛtaiśvaryaṃ whose prosperity was made by boons, sā she, taṃ him, prāpya having obtained, patiṃ husband, priyam dear, āsīt became, devavatī Devavati, tuṣṭā pleased, dhanaṃ wealth, prāpya having obtained, iva as if, nirdhanaḥ a poor man.

40019974.author: Translation
40019974.content: Having obtained him, her dear husband whose prosperity was due to boons, Devavati became as pleased as a poor man who has acquired wealth.

40019975.author: पदार्थः
40019975.content: sa he, tayā with her, saha together, saṃyuktaḥ united, rarāja shone, rajanīcaraḥ the night-wanderer, añjanāt from Anjana mountain, abhiniṣkrāntaḥ having emerged, kareṇvā with a female elephant, iva as if, mahāgajaḥ a great elephant.

40019975.author: Translation
40019975.content: United with her, that Rakshasa shone like a great elephant emerging from the Anjana mountain with a female elephant.

40019976.author: पदार्थः
40019976.content: devavatyāṃ in Devavati, sukeśaḥ Sukesha, tu indeed, janayāmāsa begot, rāghava O Raghava.

40019976.author: Translation
40019976.content: Indeed, Sukesha begot children in Devavati, O Raghava.

40019977.author: पदार्थः
40019977.content: trīn three, putrān sons, janayāmāsa begot, tretāgnisamavigrahān whose bodies were like the three sacred fires, mālyavantaṃ Malyavan, sumāliṃ Sumali, ca and, māliṃ Mali, ca and, balināṃ among the strong, varam the best, trīn three, trinetrasamān equal to the three-eyed one (Shiva), putrān sons, rākṣasān Rakshasas, rākṣasādhipaḥ the lord of Rakshasas.

40019977.author: Translation
40019977.content: The lord of Rakshasas begot three sons, Malyavan, Sumali, and Mali (the best among the strong), who were Rakshasas with bodies like the three sacred fires and equal to Shiva.

40019978.author: पदार्थः
40019978.content: त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, इव like, अव्यग्राः undisturbed, स्थिताः stood, त्रयः three, इव like, अग्नयः fires, त्रयः three, मन्त्राः incantations, इव like, अत्युग्राः extremely fierce, त्रयः three, घोराः dreadful, इव like, आमयाः diseases

40019978.author: Translation
40019978.content: They remained like the three undisturbed worlds, like the three sacred fires, like three extremely fierce incantations, and like three dreadful diseases.

40019979.author: पदार्थः
40019979.content: त्रयः three, सुकेशस्य of Sukesha, सुताः sons, त्रेताग्निसमतेजसः having splendor equal to the three sacred fires, विवृद्धिम् growth, अगमन् attained, तत्र there, व्याधयः diseases, उपेक्षिताः neglected, इव like

40019979.author: Translation
40019979.content: The three sons of Sukesha, possessing a brilliance akin to the three sacred fires, grew there like neglected diseases.

40019980.author: पदार्थः
40019980.content: वरप्राप्तिम् the obtaining of a boon, पितुः of their father, ते they, तु indeed, ज्ञात्वा having known, ईश्वरतपोबलात् from the power of Shiva's penance, तपः penance, तप्तुम् to perform, गताः went, मेरुम् to Mount Meru, भ्रातरः brothers, कृतनिश्चयाः having made a firm resolve

40019980.author: Translation
40019980.content: Having learned of their father's boon obtained through the power of Shiva's penance, the brothers, having made a firm resolve, went to Mount Meru to perform penance.

40019981.author: पदार्थः
40019981.content: प्रगृह्य having undertaken, नियमान् vows, घोरान् terrible, राक्षसाः the Rakshasas, नृपसत्तम O best of kings, विचेरुः they performed, ते they, तपः penance, घोरम् terrible, सर्वभूतभयावहम् causing fear to all beings

40019981.author: Translation
40019981.content: O best of kings, those Rakshasas undertook severe vows and performed terrible penance that instilled fear in all beings.

40019982.author: पदार्थः
40019982.content: सत्यार्जवशमोपेतैः endowed with truth, straightforwardness, and self-control, तपोभिः by penances, अतिदुष्करैः extremely difficult to perform, सन्तापयन्तः causing distress, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, सदेवासुरमानुषान् along with gods, asuras, and humans

40019982.author: Translation
40019982.content: Through their extremely difficult penances, which were endowed with truth, straightforwardness, and self-control, they tormented the three worlds, including gods, asuras, and humans.

40019983.author: पदार्थः
40019983.content: ततः then, विभुः the powerful one (Brahma), चतुर्वक्त्रः four-faced, विमानवरम् the excellent aerial chariot, आस्थितः having ascended, सुकेशपुत्रान् the sons of Sukesha, आमन्त्र्य having addressed, वरदः a bestower of boons, अस्मि I am, इति thus, अभाषत spoke.

40019983.author: Translation
40019983.content: Then, the powerful, four-faced Brahma, seated on his excellent aerial chariot, addressed the sons of Sukesha, declaring, "I am here to grant boons."

40019984.author: पदार्थः
40019984.content: ब्रह्माणम् Brahma, वरदम् the bestower of boons, ज्ञात्वा having known, सेन्द्रैः with Indra, देवगणैः by hosts of gods, वृतम् surrounded, ऊचुः they spoke, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands, सर्वे all, वेपमानाः trembling, इव like, द्रुमाः trees.

40019984.author: Translation
40019984.content: Realizing that Brahma, the bestower of boons, was present, surrounded by Indra and hosts of gods, all of them spoke with folded hands, trembling like trees.

40019985.author: पदार्थः
40019985.content: तपसा by penance, आराधितः worshipped, देव O Lord, यदि if, नः to us, दिशसे you grant, वरम् a boon, अजेयाः unconquerable, शत्रुहन्तारः destroyers of enemies, तथैव and also, चिरजीविनः long-lived.

40019985.author: Translation
40019985.content: They requested, "O Lord, if you, who have been propitiated by our penance, grant us a boon, let us be unconquerable, destroyers of enemies, and also long-lived."

40019986.author: पदार्थः
40019986.content: प्रभविष्ण्वः powerful, भवाम let us be, इति thus, परस्परम् mutually, अनुव्रताः devoted.

40019986.author: Translation
40019986.content: They further requested, "And let us be mighty, always devoted to each other."

40019987.author: पदार्थः
40019987.content: एवम् thus, भविष्यति it shall be, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, सुकेशतनयान् to the sons of Sukesha, विभुः the powerful one (Brahma), सः he, ययौ went, ब्रह्मलोकाय to the world of Brahma, ब्रह्मा Brahma, ब्राह्मणवत्सलः affectionate to Brahmins.

40019987.author: Translation
40019987.content: Having told the sons of Sukesha, "So it shall be," the powerful Brahma, who is affectionate to Brahmins, then returned to his own world.

40019988.author: पदार्थः
40019988.content: वरं boon, लब्ध्वा having obtained, तु indeed, ते those, सर्वे all, राम O Rama, रात्रिञ्चराः night-wanderers, तदा then, सुरासुरान् gods and asuras, प्रबाधन्ते they harass, वरदानसुनिर्भयाः very fearless because of the boon.

40019988.author: Translation
40019988.content: O Rama, having obtained the boon, all those night-wanderers then became very fearless due to the boon and began to harass both gods and asuras.

40019989.author: पदार्थः
40019989.content: तैः by them, वध्यमानाः being tormented, त्रिदशाः the gods, सर्षिसङ्घाः along with groups of sages, सचारणाः along with Charanas, त्रातारं a protector, न not, अधिगच्छन्ति they find, निरयस्थाः those in hell, यथा just as, नराः people.

40019989.author: Translation
40019989.content: Being tormented by them, the gods, along with groups of sages and Charanas, could not find a protector, just like people suffering in hell.

40019990.author: पदार्थः
40019990.content: अथ then, ते those, विश्वकर्माणं to Vishwakarma, शिल्पिनां of artisans, वरं the best, अव्ययम् imperishable, ऊचुः they said, समेत्य having met, संहृष्टाः delighted, राक्षसाः the Rakshasas, रघुसत्तम O best of Raghu's lineage.

40019990.author: Translation
40019990.content: O best of Raghu's lineage, then those delighted Rakshasas, having met Vishwakarma, the best and imperishable among artisans, spoke to him.

40019991.author: पदार्थः
40019991.content: ओजः vigor, तेजः splendor, बलवतां of the powerful, महतां of the great, आत्मतेजसा by your own splendor, गृहकर्ता the house-builder, भवान् you, एव alone, देवानां of the gods, हृदयेप्सितम् desired by the heart.

40019991.author: Translation
40019991.content: You alone, by your own splendor, are the cherished house-builder for the great, vigorous, splendid, and powerful gods.

40019992.author: पदार्थः
40019992.content: अस्माकम् for us, अपि also, तावत् therefore, त्वं you, गृहं a house, कुरु make, महामते O great-minded one, हिमवन्तम् the Himalayas, अपाश्रित्य having resorted to, मेरुमन्दरम् Meru or Mandara, एव indeed, वा or, महेश्वरगृहप्रख्यं resembling the dwelling of Maheswara, गृहं a house, नः for us, क्रियतां let it be made, महत् great.

40019992.author: Translation
40019992.content: O great-minded one, therefore, please build a grand dwelling for us also, resembling the abode of Maheswara, either by resorting to the Himalayas or Mount Meru or Mandara.

40019993.author: पदार्थः
40019993.content: विश्वकर्मा Vishwakarma, ततः then, तेषां to them, राक्षसानां of the Rakshasas, महाभुजः the mighty-armed, निवासं dwelling place, कथयामास described, शक्रस्य of Indra, इव like, अमरावतीम् Amaravati.

40019993.author: Translation
40019993.content: Then, the mighty-armed Vishwakarma described to those Rakshasas a dwelling place, which was like Amaravati, the city of Indra.

40019994.author: पदार्थः
40019994.content: दक्षिणस्य of the southern, उदधेः ocean, तीरे on the shore, त्रिकूटो Trikuta, नाम named, पर्वतः mountain, सुवेल Suvela, इति thus, च and, अपि also, अन्यः another, द्वितीयः second, तत्र there, सत्तमाः O best ones.

40019994.author: Translation
40019994.content: O best ones, on the shore of the southern ocean, there is a mountain named Trikuta, and another, a second one, named Suvela.

40019995.author: पदार्थः
40019995.content: शिखरे on the peak, तस्य of that, शैलस्य mountain, मध्यमे middle, अम्बुदसन्निभे cloud-like, शकुनैः by birds, अपि even, दुष्प्रापे difficult to reach, टङ्कच्छिन्नचतुर्दिशि carved on all four sides with a chisel.

40019995.author: Translation
40019995.content: On the middle peak of that mountain, which resembles a cloud, is difficult for even birds to reach, and is carved on all four sides as if by a chisel.

40019996.author: पदार्थः
40019996.content: त्रिंशत् thirty, योजनक्स् yojanas, तीर्णा wide, शतयोजनम् a hundred yojanas, आयता long, स्वर्णप्राकारसंवीता surrounded by golden walls, हेमतोरणसंवृता adorned with golden archways.

40019996.author: Translation
40019996.content: This place is thirty yojanas wide and a hundred yojanas long, surrounded by golden walls and adorned with golden archways.

40019997.author: पदार्थः
40019997.content: मया by me, लङ्का Lanka, इति thus, नगरी city, शक्राज्ञप्तेन by Indra's command, निर्मिता built, तस्यां in that, वसत dwell, दुर्धर्षाः O invincible ones, यूयं you, राक्षसपुङ्गवाः O foremost Rakshasas.

40019997.author: Translation
40019997.content: This city, named Lanka, was built by me at Indra's command; O invincible and foremost Rakshasas, you should dwell there.

40019998.author: पदार्थः
40019998.content: अमरावतीं Amaravati, समासाद्य having reached, सेन्द्राः with Indra, इव like, दिवौकसः gods, लङ्कादुर्गं the fortress of Lanka, समासाद्य having reached, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, बहुभिः many, वृताः surrounded.

40019998.author: Translation
40019998.content: Having reached the fortress of Lanka, you will be surrounded by many Rakshasas, just as the gods, led by Indra, dwell in Amaravati.

40019999.author: पदार्थः
40019999.content: भविष्यथ you will become, दुराधर्षाः invincible, शत्रूणां of enemies, शत्रुसूदनाः destroyers of enemies.

40019999.author: Translation
40019999.content: You will become invincible and destroyers of your enemies.

40020000.author: पदार्थः
40020000.content: विश्वकर्मवचः the words of Vishwakarma, श्रुत्वा having heard, ततः then, ते those, राक्षसोत्तमाः best of Rakshasas, सहस्रानुचराः with thousands of followers, भूत्वा having become, गत्वा having gone, ताम् that, अवसन् dwelt, पुरीम् city.

40020000.author: Translation
40020000.content: Having heard the words of Vishwakarma, those foremost Rakshasas then went to that city with thousands of followers and dwelt there.

40020001.author: पदार्थः
40020001.content: दृढप्राकारपरिखां with strong walls and moats, हैमैः golden, गृहशतैः by hundreds of houses, वृताम् surrounded, लङ्कां Lanka, अवाप्य having obtained, ते those, हृष्टाः delighted, न्यवसन् dwelt, रजनीचराः night-wanderers (Rakshasas).

40020001.author: Translation
40020001.content: Having obtained Lanka, which was surrounded by strong walls and moats and hundreds of golden houses, those delighted night-wanderers (Rakshasas) took up residence there.

40020002.author: पदार्थः
40020002.content: एतस्मिन् in this, एव indeed, काले time, तु and, यथाकामं as desired, च and, राघव O Raghava, नर्मदा Narmada, नाम named, गन्धर्वी a Gandharva woman, बभूव was born, रघुनन्दन O delight of Raghu's lineage.

40020002.author: Translation
40020002.content: O Raghava, O delight of Raghu's lineage, at this very time, a Gandharva woman named Narmada was born as desired.

40020003.author: पदार्थः
40020003.content: तस्याः her, कान्यात्रयम् three daughters, हि indeed, आसीत् were, धीश्रीकिर्तिसमद्युति having splendor equal to intellect, prosperity, and fame, ज्येष्ठक्रमेण in order of seniority, सा she, तेषाम् of them, राक्षसानाम् of the Rākṣasas, अराक्षसी not a Rākṣasī.

40020003.author: Translation
40020003.content: She, who was not a Rākṣasī, indeed had three daughters whose splendor was equal to intellect, prosperity, and fame, and these daughters were for those Rākṣasas in order of their seniority.

40020004.author: पदार्थः
40020004.content: कन्याः daughters, ताः those, प्रददौ gave, हृष्टा delighted, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः having faces like the full moon, त्रयाणाम् to the three, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् chiefs of Rākṣasas, तिस्रः three, गन्धर्वकन्यकाः Gandharva maidens.

40020004.author: Translation
40020004.content: Delighted, she gave those three Gandharva maidens, whose faces resembled the full moon, to the three chiefs of the Rākṣasas.

40020005.author: पदार्थः
40020005.content: दत्ता given, मात्रा by the mother, महाभागा O greatly fortunate one, नक्षत्रे in the constellation, भगदैवते presided over by Bhaga, कुतदाराः having taken wives, तु indeed, ते those, राम O Rama, सुकेशतनयाः sons of Sukesha, तदा then.

40020005.author: Translation
40020005.content: O greatly fortunate Rama, those sons of Sukesha then indeed took wives, given by their mother in the constellation presided over by Bhaga.

40020006.author: पदार्थः
40020006.content: चिक्रीडुः they sported, सह with, भार्याभिः their wives, अप्सरोभिः with Apsaras, इव like, अमराः gods, ततः then, माल्यवतः of Malyavan, भार्या wife, सुन्दरी Sundari, नाम named, सुन्दरी beautiful.

40020006.author: Translation
40020006.content: They sported with their wives like gods with Apsaras; then, Malyavan's wife, named Sundari, who was beautiful...

40020007.author: पदार्थः
40020007.content: सः he, तस्याम् in her, जनयामास begot, यत् what, अपत्यम् offspring, निबोध know, तत् that, वज्रमुष्टिः Vajramushti, विरूपाक्षः Virupaksha, दुर्मुखः Durmukha, च and, एव indeed, राक्षसः Rākṣasa.

40020007.author: Translation
40020007.content: He begot in her the following offspring: Vajramushti, Virupaksha, and Durmukha, who were Rākṣasas.

40020008.author: पदार्थः
40020008.content: सुप्तघ्नो Suptaghna, यज्ञकोपश्च and Yajñakopa, मत्तोन्मत्तौ Matta and Unmatta, तथैव ca and similarly, अनला Anala, च and, अभवत् was born, कन्या a daughter, सुन्दर्यां from Sundari, राम O Rama, सुन्दरी a beautiful one

40020008.author: Translation
40020008.content: O Rama, from Sundari were born sons named Suptaghna, Yajñakopa, Matta, and Unmatta, and also a beautiful daughter named Anala.

40020009.author: पदार्थः
40020009.content: सुमालिनो of Sumali, अपि also, भार्या a wife, आसीत् was, पूर्णचद्रनिभानना with a face like the full moon, नाम्ना by name, केतुमती Ketumati, राम O Rama, प्राणेभ्यो than life, अपि even, गरीयसी dearer

40020009.author: Translation
40020009.content: O Rama, Sumali also had a wife named Ketumati, whose face was like the full moon and who was dearer to him than his own life.

40020010.author: पदार्थः
40020010.content: सुमाली Sumali, जनयामास begot, यदपत्यं what offspring, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, केतुमत्यां in Ketumati, महाराज O great king, तत् that, निबोध know, अनुपूर्वशः in due order

40020010.author: Translation
40020010.content: O great king, now learn in due order about the offspring that the demon Sumali begot through Ketumati.

40020011.author: पदार्थः
40020011.content: प्रहस्तो Prahasta, अकम्पनश्चैव and Akampana, विकटः Vikata, कालकार्मुखः Kalakarmukha, धूम्राक्षश्चैव and Dhūmrākṣa, दण्डश्च and Danda, सुपार्श्वश्च and Suparshva, महाबलः the mighty

40020011.author: Translation
40020011.content: These sons were Prahasta, Akampana, Vikata, Kalakarmukha, Dhūmrākṣa, Danda, and the mighty Suparshva.

40020012.author: पदार्थः
40020012.content: संह्रादिः Samhradi, प्रघसश्चैव and Praghasa, भासकर्णश्च and Bhasakarna, राक्षसः the demon, राका Raka, पुष्पोत्कटा Pushpotkata, चैव and, कैकसी Kaikasi, च and, शुचिस्मिता with a pure smile, कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, च and, इत्येते these, सुमालेः of Sumali, प्रसवाः offspring, स्मृताः are known

40020012.author: Translation
40020012.content: The demon's other offspring were Samhradi, Praghasa, Bhasakarna, Raka, Pushpotkata, Kaikasi of the pure smile, and Kumbhinasi, all known as Sumali's progeny.

40020013.author: पदार्थः
40020013.content: कुम्भीनसी Kumbhinasi, च and, इत्येते these, सुमालेः of Sumali, प्रसवाः offspring, स्मृताः are known।

40020013.author: Translation
40020013.content: Kumbhinasi and others are known as the offspring of Sumali.

40020014.author: पदार्थः
40020014.content: मालेः Of Mali, तु indeed, वसुधा Vasudha, नाम named, गन्धर्वी a Gandharva woman, रूपशालिनी beautiful, भार्या wife, आसीत् was, पद्मपत्राक्षी lotus-leaf-eyed, स्वक्षी beautiful-eyed, यक्षीवरोपमा resembling the best of Yakshinis।

40020014.author: Translation
40020014.content: Mali's wife was a beautiful Gandharva woman named Vasudha, who had eyes like lotus petals and was as splendid as a chief Yakshini.

40020015.author: पदार्थः
40020015.content: सुमालेः Of Sumali, अनुजः the younger brother, तस्यां in her, जनयामास begot, यत् what, प्रभो O Lord, अपत्यं offspring, कथ्यमानं being told, तु indeed, मया by me, त्वं you, शृणु listen, राघव O Raghava।

40020015.author: Translation
40020015.content: O Lord Raghava, listen to the offspring that Sumali's younger brother begot in her, which I am now relating to you.

40020016.author: पदार्थः
40020016.content: अनिलः Anila, च and, अनलः Anala, च and, एव indeed, हरः Hara, सम्पातिः Sampati, एव indeed, च and, एते these, विभीषणामात्याः ministers of Vibhishana, मालेयाः sons of Mali, तु indeed, निशाचरः night-wanderers।

40020016.author: Translation
40020016.content: Anila, Anala, Hara, and Sampati are these sons of Mali, who were night-wanderers and later became ministers of Vibhishana.

40020017.author: पदार्थः
40020017.content: ततः Then, तु indeed, ते those, राक्षसपुङ्गवाः chief Rakshasas, त्रयः three, निशाचरैः by night-wanderers, पुत्रशतैः by hundreds of sons, च and, संवृताः surrounded, सुरान् the gods, सहेन्द्रान् along with Indra, ऋषिनागयक्षान् the Rishis, Nagas, and Yakshas, बबाधिरे tormented, तान् them, बहुवीर्यदर्पिताः arrogant with great power।

40020017.author: Translation
40020017.content: Then, those three chief Rakshasas, surrounded by hundreds of their Rakshasa sons, became arrogant with their immense power and tormented the gods along with Indra, as well as the Rishis, Nagas, and Yakshas.

40020018.author: पदार्थः
40020018.content: जगत् world, भ्रमन्तः wandering, अनिलवत् like wind, दुरासदा difficult to approach, रणेषु in battles, मृत्युप्रतिमानतेजसः having valor equal to death, वरप्रदानात् due to the boon, अतिगर्विताः extremely proud, भृशम् exceedingly, क्रतुक्रियाणाम् of sacrificial rites, प्रशमङ्कराः destroyers, सदा always.

40020018.author: Translation
40020018.content: These beings wander the world like the wind, are difficult to approach, possess valor equal to death in battles, are exceedingly proud due to the boon they received, and always destroy sacrificial rites. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चमः सर्गः ।। 5 ।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
